claims.claim: A $10,000 TFSA contribution that falls to $6,000 does not restore the $4,000 loss as contribution room; only an actual withdrawal creates new room the following calendar year.
claims.episode_span: You contribute $10,000 from available TFSA room to a stock that later falls to $6,000. The $4,000 decline does not restore room because the Canada Revenue Agency only counts withdrawals, not unrealized or realized losses inside the account.
claims.supporting_quote: If I withdraw the $6,000, that amount generally comes back as room the next calendar year
